retentionPolicy: Keep incident records until manually reviewed; repeated observations update lastSeen and occurrenceCount instead of duplicating identical log evidence.

incidents.title: Cloudflare Doctor could not complete inspection
incidents.rootCause: Missing CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID. Configure these as GitHub Actions repository secrets.
incidents.nextStep: Configure Cloudflare Pages read access for CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN and CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.
incidents.latestNextStep: Create a CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN secret with Cloudflare Pages read access; the account ID is configured in the workflow.

incidents.title: Cloudflare Pages dependency install crashed in npm
incidents.rootCause: Cloudflare deployment f87e6602 failed during dependency installation with npm error: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'edgesOut'). The log shows npm 10.9.9 on Node.js 22.23.4; the failure occurred before the production build. This identifies the failing phase but does not prove a single underlying package or npm bug.

firstEvidence.log: npm error Cannot read properties of null (reading 'edgesOut')

latestEvidence.log: npm error Cannot read properties of null (reading 'edgesOut')

incidents.nextStep: Keep the first failed deployment and the successful follow-up together. Verify clean dependency installs in Cloudflare and CI; if the crash recurs, compare npm versions and introduce a committed lockfile only after validating it.
incidents.latestNextStep: A later deployment succeeded after the .npmrc mitigation was added, but the underlying cause is not yet proven.
